card.name: Words just before a quantity like most or all
card.fires_on: Function words, verbs or commas right before a quantity phrase such as 'a majority of', 'the vast majority of', 'more than 10 percent', 'nearly all' or 'every one'. It fires on the word before the quantity, not on the quantity itself.

modes.label: Before majority or share
modes.description: A verb or preposition leading into a majority, vast majority or percentage share.
modes.example: in which a small number of jurisdictions are responsible<< for>> the vast majority of federal death sentences.

modes.label: Before all or every
modes.description: A verb or linking word leading into 'nearly all', 'all' or 'every one'.
modes.example: Solar, wind and other renewable sources can<< meet>> nearly all of North Carolina’s energy needs

modes.label: Comma before a count
modes.description: A comma or dash where a number or proportion phrase is expected next.

card.writes: It promotes 'every' and suppresses 'half' and 'third' words, so it pushes toward 'every' or 'all' wording over fractions.
card.plain: It fires on the word just before a phrase like 'most of' or 'every one of', where a quantity is about to be stated.
